Lodestone Brand.name: Lodestone Brand
Lodestone Brand.description: The user touches a target and leaves a lasting pole on them for a full day. Wherever the target goes in the city, the user feels the direction and rough distance of the brand, and whenever the target comes within a street's width, the user can slam them to the nearest steel or to the ground: at full strength the target takes heavy force damage, and held back they are only pinned until they wrench free with a hard effort. The user holds one brand at a time, and while it lasts every other use of the Quirk reaches only half as far. Strain: severe.
